page.overview:
Who is Tuon?

Fortuona Athaem Devi Paendrag is the current Empress of Seanchan (although she is only recognized in the occupied territories across the Eastern Sea). From her sixth birthday until her accession as Empress, she was known as Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag, the Daughter of the Nine Moons, heir to the throne, as the second and favorite daughter of the late Empress Radhanan.

Raised in the Imperial family, Tuon enjoyed training horses and damane and was brought up by her nursemaid and bodyguard, Selucia. When the Empress declared the Corenne to retake their ancestral homelands, Tuon journeyed east to the Empire's newly occupied territories, and received a fortune from a damane concerning the man she would marry. In the conquered city of Ebou Dar, Tuon finds Mat Cauthon trying to escape with damane and is kidnapped by him and made to pose as his servant. Furyk Karede negotiates Tuon's freedom with her kidnapper, and she decides to marry Mat after he has fulfilled all the conditions of her fortune.

Tuon returns to Ebou Dar just as Semirhage has slaughtered the Imperial family in Seandar, leaving the Seanchan homeland in chaos and Tuon as the sole heir. After failing to make an agreement with the Dragon Reborn, she declares herself Empress Fortuona and agrees to a great raid on the White Tower to capture Aes Sedai as marath'damane. However, the Empress agrees to fight with the other nations in the Last Battle and set aside their differences to crush the Shadow, where she makes use of Min Farshaw's viewings and names the woman Doomseer. At the end of the battle, the Empress has a conversation with her ancestor, Artur Hawkwing, and learns that she is pregnant with an heir to the empire.

She is dark and petite with large brown eyes, a heart-shaped face and full lips. As a mark of her station, her head is shaved and she has long, lacquered fingernails. Her rather underdeveloped figure, combined with her short stature, lack of hair, and small bust size have had the unfortunate result of causing virtually everyone she meets to initially mistake her either for a very young girl or a boy.

Also known as: Fortuona, Daughter of the Nine Moons.
